slides.texte_overlay:
When a strong man
chooses to say nothing

1.
When someone insults him
to get a reaction.

2.
When he's about to promise
something he can't keep.

3.
When a colleague takes the credit.
The work will speak.

4.
When a friend shares a secret
about someone else.

5.
When he doesn't know enough yet.
He listens, then learns.
